Let \(n=4041\). We have
\[
(10^{2021}-1)(10^{2020}-1)=10^{4041}-(10^{2021}+10^{2020}-1).
\]
Now
\[
10^{2021}+10^{2020}-1
\]
is the 4041-digit string
\[
\underbrace{00\cdots0}_{2019}1\,0\,\underbrace{99\cdots9}_{2020}.
\]
Subtracting this from \(10^{4041}-1=\underbrace{99\cdots9}_{4041}\) gives
\[
\underbrace{99\cdots9}_{2019}8\,9\,\underbrace{00\cdots0}_{2020}.
\]
Adding \(1\) gives the product:
\[
\underbrace{99\cdots9}_{2019}8\,9\,\underbrace{00\cdots0}_{2019}1.
\]
Thus the digit sum is
\[
2019\cdot 9+8+9+1=18171+18=18189.
\]
\[
\boxed{18189}
\]
